source_user: A service receives a mix of short prompts and long generations. Design an evaluation plan that reports TTFT, TPOT, throughput, queueing, and P99 latency. Scenario variant 283: include an explicit falsifiable hypothesis and a controlled experiment.
source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. Minimum technical points: separate prefill and decode behavior; fix workload distribution; report warmup; use repeated trials; capture GPU memory and request-level traces.
corrected_answer:
For scenario variant 283, evaluate the candidate against a pinned baseline with randomized, paired replay of the same immutable trace. Declare model/tokenizer, precision, hardware, software build, scheduler, batching, routing, admission, autoscaling, clock sync, cache state, clock source, and instrumentation; record deviations instead of assuming them. Publish the short/long prompt and requested-output distributions, stratify by input tokens, output tokens, offered load/concurrency, and cache state, and predeclare seeds, warm-up exclusion, at least five independent paired repetitions, exclusion/stopping rules, and a correctness oracle.

Falsifiable hypothesis: in each prespecified stratum the candidate raises correct SLO-goodput by at least 10%, with error rate and end-to-end P99 latency no more than 5% worse than baseline. Reject the claim if paired confidence intervals miss either margin. Capture synchronized ingress, admission, queue release, prefill start/end, first-token, each decode step, completion, timeout, cancellation, retry, and correctness events. Define queue-inclusive TTFT as first-token minus ingress, compute-only TTFT as first-token minus prefill start, TPOT as decode duration divided by a declared generated-token denominator, throughput as completed output tokens per wall-clock second, queueing as admission minus ingress, and P99 over completed requests; report prefill and decode separately.

Measure correctness, timeouts, cancellations, retries, SLO-goodput, request/token throughput, TTFT, TPOT, queue time, end-to-end latency, P50/P95/P99, GPU memory/KV occupancy, utilization, power, clocks, temperature, CPU, network, and allocator/eviction events. Use paired bootstrap or an explicitly justified uncertainty method, show sample counts and missing/failure denominators, and preserve raw traces and configs. Confounders include cache warmth, prompt mix, arrival-burst shape, batching/admission decisions, autoscaling, background load, thermal throttling, clock skew, retries, and instrumentation overhead. Run a small canary before production; halt and revert to the pinned baseline on correctness regression, error/SLO breach, unsafe resource pressure, or a prespecified P99/error guardrail violation. Results are provisional until independent domain review.
risks: The hypothesis thresholds, workload strata, and confidence method are design choices and require domain review; no platform-specific performance is inferred.
Cache state, batching/admission, retries, autoscaling, thermal/resource contention, clock skew, tokenizer/model changes, and instrumentation overhead can confound latency and goodput.
evidence_required: Versioned model/tokenizer, runtime, hardware, scheduler, routing, batching, admission, autoscaling, cache, and instrumentation configuration.
Immutable paired traces plus raw request lifecycle events, correctness oracle results, failure/timeout/retry records, resource telemetry, and uncertainty calculations across all prespecified strata.
